parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the region where the route table resides.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.

parameters.name: RouteEntryType
parameters.description:
The type of the route. Valid values:
- **all**: all route types.
- **custom**: custom route.
- **system**: system route.
- **bgp**: BGP route.
- **cen**: Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) route.
- **type_vpn_bgp_internal**: VPN BGP route.
- **ECR**: Express Connect Router (ECR) route.

parameters.name: RouteTableId
parameters.description: The ID of the route table to query.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the VPC to which the route table belongs.
